header.subtitle: Upload template and annotate with student data fields

alerts.missingFields: Please upload a template and map some fields first.

help.title: Getting Started with Certificate Generation
help.step1: Upload a certificate template (PDF or image) using the upload area above
help.step2: Switch to "Design" view to map data fields onto your template
help.step3: Drag fields from the palette onto the template where you want data to appear
help.step4: Use "Preview" to see how certificates will look with real student data
help.step5: Click "Generate Certificates" to create and download all certificates
